dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with pronounced curvature originating from the posterior base toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; lacking acute or sharp terminal points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin exhibiting a steep ascent of approximately 55 degrees relative to the visible dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base chord to vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular white depigmented punctations scattered across the lateral fin surface; subtle notch or irregularity at the posterior-most insertion point of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white speckling pattern concentrated primarily on the posterior half of the dorsal fin blade.
